selection.rule: STUDY v0.8 section 8.7: per-run step envelope on G in H; D_conf = D_screen intersected with the allowances where CH-8 is feasible in every confirmation seed (empty gives INCOMPLETE); D_C2 = D_band = {g in D_conf : g >= g*} with g* frozen in S2 (option b of 19.2 item 12; empty gives INCOMPLETE (no band)) or D_conf (option a); BEST, form and g* fixed by the screen; PID selection as 8.6 (highest validation top-1 among checkpoints with frozen H <= 350,000 passing Chang's filter, never the closest over-budget point); verdicts resting on a degenerate layer among Q, K, V, O and the FFN contraction, binary or HGQ, defined by effect, are labelled 'with degenerate <layer> (<route>)'

interval_method: paired t over seeds (df = n - 1). C2 intersection-union test over D_C2: at every g in D_C2, two-sided interval at level L, lower bound > 0 for ABOVE ON GRID; under option (b) the same test over all of D_conf is reported beside as the nested strong form, adding no alpha. L = 1 - 0.05/2 when C2 shares alpha = 0.05 with C3 (options A, B) or with C3r (option C with option (c)); 0.95 for C2 alone (option C). C3 PID and C3r ramp-350k: same level. Variant offered to Kai under option (c), not the default: when 350,000 is in D_C2, C3r's null implies C2's null, so C3r could be tested at C2's own level with no added alpha (C2 at 0.95 and 0.836 s_d under option C); it applies only if 350,000 is in D_C2, fixed on validation before the held-out read; the pre-registered default remains the Bonferroni split. Descriptive CROSSING/LOCAL labels: simultaneous Bonferroni over 7 contrasts (6 grid + PID) or 6 (option C). C4 firmware dominance (only where C2 is ABOVE ON GRID): per g in D_C2 the level-L paired t interval on LUT_BEST - LUT_CH-8 at one part, stage and settings; LUT ADVANTAGE if upper bound < 0, NOT A LUT ADVANTAGE if lower bound >= 0, else UNRESOLVED; supported only with LUT ADVANTAGE and a post-trace accuracy lower bound > 0 at every g in D_C2. C6 (secondary): ordinary 95 percent paired t intervals for the mean ablation, the static-attention ablation (per-(head, query, key) validation-mean probabilities after the softmax output quantizer, the mean accumulated in float64 and cast back) and the zero-logit ablation (logits 0 through the model's own QSoftmax), all > 0; entropy of row-renormalized post-quantizer probabilities < log 8 in every seed (consistency check); no degenerate K, V or O by effect; a degenerate Q gives 'used, with input-independent queries', or 'used, as query-independent attention pooling' where Q_t is identical across query positions; a Q equal to 0 at every element is reported as for a degenerate K ('input-independent attention weights'), with no change to any C6 outcome (its logits are 0, so the static-attention ablation is 0); beside each ablation, the count of validation entries where a downstream datalane WRAP quantizer receives a value outside its (k, i, f) range (O's input quantizer for the static and zero-logit ablations, the second tanh table's input quantizer for the mean ablation), with the unablated model's count as baseline and the label 'overflow-affected' when nonzero, and for the entropy the rows with any negative post-quantizer entry counted separately; the C6 rule is unchanged and a C6 statement resting on an overflow-affected ablation carries the label; reported per g, overall at every g in D_C2.
